name: Haruyama Yurine
source:
A college student who lives in the same building as Atsushi. Her large chest makes her the object of much attention, especially at the college, but the stiff shoulders it causes have her go to Relaxation Yubihara for help. It turns out, however, that the weight on her chest isn’t all that’s hurting her shoulders.

[From [url=https://www.gematsu.com/games/beat-refle]Gematsu[/url]]
